use tracing_subscriber::EnvFilter;

struct Local;

impl Local {
    fn unwrap_or_else(&self) -> EnvFilter {
        EnvFilter::new("info")
    }
}

pub fn init_tracing() {
    let filter = match EnvFilter::try_from_default_env() {
        Ok(filter) => filter,
        Err(_) => Local.unwrap_or_else(),
    };
    let _ = tracing_subscriber::fmt().with_env_filter(filter).try_init();
}
